name: Kargal Battlescar
summary: At the Far Watch Post, Kargal Battlescar guards the eastern edge of the Barrens. He watches the crossing from Durotar, judges incoming recruits, and sends capable fighters west to strengthen Horde defenses.

sections.title: Sentinel of the Border
sections.body: Kargal Battlescar watches the road into the Barrens from the Far Watch Post. Travelers and new adventurers cross the bridge over the Southfury River, leaving the Valley of Trials behind. The Barrens is a dangerous, contested land, where aggressive wildlife, centaur raiders, and quilboar tribes threaten the frontier. Kargal inspects those who pass and gathers willing recruits for the Horde. He sends them onward to the Crossroads, where they can aid local commanders in securing the frontier.

faq.answer: Kargal Battlescar commands the Far Watch Post, guarding the eastern road from Durotar into the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Far Watch Post?
faq.answer: The Far Watch Post warns of threats near the Durotar border and along the Southfury River, and helps defend the Barrens.

faq.q: Where does Kargal send new recruits?
faq.answer: Kargal directs recruits west along the main road to the Crossroads, the Barrens' central military hub.

angles.text: As a fresh Horde adventurer leaving Durotar, you meet Kargal Battlescar at the edge of the wider struggles across Kalimdor. He gathers recruits for the conflicts in the Barrens.
As a warrior, you can see Kargal's battle hardened experience in the marks of combat he bears. He shows the resilience expected of Horde frontline fighters in the frontier.
